body:
Logic audit — minimum measurable gates and contradictions:

A. ‘Within 5 seconds / max 3’
• Start clock at STT final event receipt; stop when Console renders an eligible candidate. Human approval/publication excluded and stated explicitly.
• Test on a frozen representative Korean corpus including numbers, proper nouns, and Korean-English code-switch; report n, network profile, and cold/warm cache separately.
• Guarded-pilot gate: p95 <=5.0s, hard cutoff at 5s with abstention, <=3 rendered candidates, no late candidate silently inserted for a stale slide. At least 100 claim events is a minimum engineering sample, not a population claim.
• Relevance gate: top-3 contains at least one expert-judged directly useful candidate in >=80% of answerable events; abstains on >=95% of intentionally unanswerable events.

B. Audience usefulness
• Within-subject comparison: slides-only vs one triggered curated card, counterbalanced, target-user talks/questions.
• Minimum progression gate: source recall or answer correctness improves >=10 percentage points, while core-slide recall decreases <5 points; distraction reports <20%; no evidence of longer Q&A response time.
• A 10-person study is formative only. Pilot release instead requires all participants complete setup/reveal/retract/recovery and zero privacy-critical mistakes. Any efficacy/superiority claim needs an a-priori powered study.

C. Presenter approval burden
• Candidate view-to-decision median <=2s, p90 <=5s.
• <=1 induced speech pause per 10-minute talk; workload delta <1 point on a 7-point effort item; missed/wrong approval <5%; slide-change stale candidate approval exactly 0.
• If this fails, route approval to teammate operator or pre-show curation; do not ‘improve’ it with more AI.

D. Two-screen recovery
• Named matrix: Chrome + Edge on one supported Windows version; wired Extend, Duplicate/mirror with second-device Console, single-screen fallback.
• Three full rehearsals per required mode; zero unrecoverable failures. Popup denial, fullscreen exit, WSS loss each recover <=30s; reconnect->canonical snapshot p95 <=2s over >=50 trials.
• Live Win+P Extend->Duplicate switch with projector recording is mandatory. Any private pixel appears => co-resident Console cannot support a zero-leak claim; second-device Console becomes secure default for both modes.

E. ‘Anytime retract’
• Replace with: accepted retract produces an ordered Stage tombstone p95 <=500ms while connected; reconnect snapshot excludes revoked card; offline Stage freezes last confirmed state with stale/disconnected indicator and never resurrects it. Same contract for slide-change stale.
• Over >=100 retract/reconnect sequences: zero resurrection, zero out-of-order visible reappearance.

F. False support/conflict
• Distinguish CURATED_PREAPPROVED from LIVE_VERIFIED.
• Public-live gate: false-SUPPORT <=1%; wrong numeric/date/entity publication =0 in frozen acceptance corpus; false-CONFLICT tracked separately and <=5%; injected conflicting authoritative sources must never auto-publish; unsupported/unanswerable abstention >=95%.
• Measure reviewer agreement and adjudicate disagreements; architecture cannot define semantic truth.

G. Does presenter-only evidence + preapproved library satisfy stated MVP?
• It satisfies a first curated-evidence demo and a valuable guarded interaction milestone.
• It does NOT fully satisfy the application’s final MVP promise: the application explicitly promises automatic related-material recommendation after speech, within 5s, with original sources. Calling curated-only the final MVP would be scope relabeling.
• A compliant guarded-pilot MVP can satisfy the promise by producing <=3 LIVE_VERIFIED candidates privately within 5s while publishing only curated cards. But if ‘recommend’ is interpreted as audience-visible live material, then private-only still falls short; the application wording needs formal clarification/change.

Architecture cannot resolve these contradictions:
1) Evidence increases trust vs distracts from the talk.
2) Presenter approval protects safety vs imposes enough load to harm delivery.
3) ‘5 seconds’ begins at speech onset, semantic completion, or STT finalization.
4) ‘Related’ means topical, claim-supporting, or actionable for Q&A.
5) Human approval vs p7-9 language suggesting SUPPORTED may publish automatically.
6) Mirror/extend convenience vs literal no-private-pixel exposure during topology transition.
7) False-SUPPORT ground truth and acceptable risk vary by claim class; numeric/medical/legal claims likely need stricter or excluded scope.

Recommended contract: first demo = curated reveal. Guarded-pilot MVP = both modes + private live candidates <=5s + explicit curated publication. Public LIVE_VERIFIED evidence is a later earned release.
summary: Numeric outcome gates and unresolved product contradictions
